contentPolicy.intro: This policy sets the rules for content published on KIOSQUI: what may be posted, what is prohibited, and how we respond to violations. It is designed to protect the community from fraud, misleading content, and practices that damage trust in the platform.

summary.title: 1. Summary and purpose
summary.body: This policy defines what content is acceptable on KIOSQUI and what content is prohibited. It applies to property listings, photos, descriptions, comments, messages, and any other content uploaded to the platform. Its goal is to protect potential buyers and renters and keep the community trustworthy for everyone.

items.properties: Houses, apartments, and land that you have the legal right to sell or rent.
items.photos: Real photos of the property, taken or produced specifically for that property.
items.renders: 3D renders as long as you clearly state in the description that the property is planned or under construction.
items.descriptions: Honest descriptions: features, materials, general location, neighborhood, access, views.
items.glb: 3D files (GLB) of the property — for users on a paid plan.

prohibited.title: 3. Prohibited content
prohibited.intro: The following listings will be removed and may lead to account sanctions:

items.scams: Scams or misleading listings: nonexistent properties, deliberately false prices to attract interest, contracts on non-urban land presented as urbanized, etc.
items.noRights: Listings without rights: properties that do not belong to the advertiser and where the advertiser lacks authorization from the owner.
items.discrimination: Discrimination: excluding potential buyers or renters based on race, gender, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, marital status, family situation, or disability.
items.illegal: Violent, sexual, or illegal content in photos, descriptions, or messages.
items.crime: Properties intended for illegal activities (money laundering, trafficking, etc.).
items.copyright: Listings that infringe copyright (photos copied without permission, protected plans).

items.own: Photos must be of the actual property; stock images, internet screenshots, and photos of other properties are not valid.
items.resolution: Recommended minimum resolution: 800×600 px. Maximum 8 MB per file.
items.formats: Accepted formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, GIF. Maximum 10 images per listing.
items.watermarks: Do not include watermarks from other real estate agencies or portals without authorization.
items.faces: Do not show people's faces without their consent (neighbors, current tenants). If children appear, they must be pixelated.
items.edits: Do not use sexually suggestive, violent, or misleadingly edited images (fake skies, pasted gardens, nonexistent areas).

contact.title: 5. Contact information
contact.intro: KIOSQUI provides internal messaging and notifications so buyers and sellers can communicate without leaving the platform. For safety, it is prohibited to include the following in descriptions or photos:

items.payments: Requesting transfers or payments before validating the property.
items.external: Redirecting contact to external portals or social networks to evade our policies or reporting system.
items.impersonation: Impersonating another advertiser or using someone else's name/photo without authorization.

contact.note: Sharing phone or email in the description is allowed, but we recommend keeping the conversation on KIOSQUI so the history remains available in case of a dispute.

items.duplicates: Posting the same property multiple times under different profiles or titles to inflate visibility.
items.unavailable: Marking properties as active after they have already been sold or rented in order to capture leads.
items.clickbait: Advertising a much lower price than the real one (clickbait) and later quoting a higher price when contacted.
items.automation: Manipulating listing dates or statuses through automation.

impersonation.title: 7. Impersonation
impersonation.body: It is prohibited to create accounts that pretend to be another person, company, or entity, or to use third-party names, logos, or brands without authorization. Using false identities during verification may result in a permanent ban.

spam.title: 8. Spam and abuse
spam.intro: We keep the platform free of spam through these rules:

items.messages: Do not send unsolicited mass messages to users.
items.comments: Do not use comments to promote external services unrelated to the property.
items.links: Do not post links to phishing sites, suspicious downloads, or known scams.
items.bots: Do not use bots to create accounts or listings.

report.title: 9. How to report content
report.body: If you find a listing or comment that violates this policy, you can report it using the “Report” button available on each listing and comment. The report reaches the support panel and is reviewed by severity.
report.confidential: Reports are handled confidentially; your identity is not revealed to the reported user.

sanctions.title: 10. Sanctions
sanctions.intro: Depending on severity and recurrence, we may apply:

items.hide: Hide the listing until you correct it.
items.delete: Delete the listing without the option to edit it.
items.suspend: Temporary suspension of the account (7 / 15 / 30 days or a custom period).
items.ban: Permanent ban in serious cases (fraud, impersonation, illegal content).
items.refund: Campaign refund as reusable credit if the sanction interrupts an active campaign.

sanctions.terms: The full sanction conditions are detailed in the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms>.

appeals.title: 11. Appeals
appeals.body: If you believe a sanction was unfair, you may appeal it from the blocked login screen. The appeal creates a priority ticket that will be handled by a different agent from the one who applied the sanction. While the appeal is open, the sanction remains in place; if the appeal succeeds, we will restore your account and listings when possible.

terms.intro: Welcome to KIOSQUI, a digital real estate platform. These Terms govern the relationship between you as a user and KIOSQUI when you browse, publish, or contact others through the site. We invite you to read them carefully.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of the Terms
acceptance.p1: By creating an account, publishing a property, or using any KIOSQUI feature, you accept these Terms and Conditions in full. If you disagree with any part, you must not use the platform.
acceptance.p2: These Terms form a binding agreement between you and KIOSQUI. We recommend reading them together with our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <content>Content Policy</content>.

about.title: 2. Who we are
about.p1: KIOSQUI is a digital platform based in the Republic of Guatemala that allows owners, agents, and companies to advertise, search, and connect for the purchase, sale, or rental of real estate (houses, apartments, and land).
about.p2: KIOSQUI does not own the listed properties and does not directly participate in transactions between users. We operate as a technology intermediary that facilitates contact between parties.

account.title: 3. User account
account.intro: To publish or contact sellers, you must create an account. By doing so, you declare that:

items.age: You are at least 18 years old.
items.truth: The information provided (name, email, phone number) is truthful and up to date.
items.password: You will keep your password confidential; you are responsible for all activity performed from your account.
items.unauthorized: You will immediately report any unauthorized access through the <support>support portal</support>.

account.p2: KIOSQUI may suspend or delete your account if it detects fraudulent use, impersonation, or repeated violation of these Terms.

verification.title: 4. Identity verification
verification.intro: To access certain features (such as becoming a verified seller, uploading 3D files, receiving ad credit, or managing a company), you must complete identity verification by sending:

items.id: Valid DPI or passport (individuals) — only the number is stored, encrypted.
items.tax: Valid NIT and RTU from SAT (companies or businesses).

verification.p2: These documents are processed only to validate identity. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for how we store and protect them. Verification approval is at KIOSQUI's discretion; we may request additional information.

listings.title: 5. Property listings
listings.intro: As an advertiser, you are solely responsible for the content and truthfulness of your listings. You agree to:

items.rights: Publish only properties for which you have the legal right to sell or rent (ownership, power of attorney, mandate).
items.photos: Upload real photos of the property — no stock images, undisclosed renders, or photos of other properties.
items.truth: State the price, location, area, and property features in good faith.
items.status: Mark the listing as Sold or Paused when it is no longer available.
items.policy: Comply with the <content>Content Policy</content> (image, contact, language, and other restrictions).

listings.p2: Listings with false information or policy violations may be hidden or removed without prior notice and may lead to account sanctions.

plans.title: 6. Plans, payments, and subscriptions
plans.p1: KIOSQUI offers a free plan with listing limits and paid plans with higher quotas, team management, and access to 3D files (GLB). Prices and terms for each plan are shown on the <plans>plans</plans> page.

items.providers: Payments are processed through authorized payment providers; KIOSQUI does not store complete card data.
items.renewal: Subscriptions renew automatically for the contracted period unless you cancel before expiration.
items.refunds: Refunds: plans are non-refundable once activated, except for a technical error attributable to KIOSQUI or a legal requirement.

ads.title: 7. Ads and featured listings
ads.body: You may <pauta>promote</pauta> a listing so it appears as featured in listing pages and home sections. Ads have dynamic pricing based on duration and segmentation. If an ad is not consumed due to sanction or suspension, KIOSQUI may refund it as internal credit reusable for future campaigns.

sanctions.title: 8. Sanctions, suspension, and bans
sanctions.intro: KIOSQUI may apply the following sanctions when these Terms or the Content Policy are violated:

items.warning: Warning — notification to the user with instructions.
items.hide: Hide listing — the listing stops being visible until corrected.
items.suspend: Temporary suspension — account block for 7, 15, 30 days, or a custom period.

sanctions.p2: Any sanction may be appealed from the blocked login screen, creating a high-priority support ticket. The support team will review the case and resolve it within a reasonable timeframe.

ip.title: 9. Intellectual property
ip.p1: The KIOSQUI name, logo, source code, design, illustrations, and other elements are the property of their respective owners and are protected by Guatemalan copyright and trademark law and applicable international treaties.
ip.p2: The photos and descriptions you upload to your listings are yours or are uploaded with express authorization. By publishing them on KIOSQUI, you grant us a non-exclusive, revocable, free, worldwide license to display, resize, and process that content solely to operate the platform.

liability.title: 10. Limitation of liability
liability.intro: KIOSQUI is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the fullest extent permitted by law:

items.availability: We do not guarantee that the platform will be free of interruptions, errors, or vulnerabilities.
items.transactions: We are not a party to, and do not endorse, real estate transactions between users. Verifying ownership, legal conditions, areas, boundaries, and actual prices is the responsibility of the parties.
items.damages: We are not responsible for indirect damages, lost profits, lost opportunities, or claims arising from contact between users outside the platform.

changes.title: 11. Changes to these Terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms at any time. The new version will take effect when published on this page. If the changes are significant, we will notify registered users by email or platform notice at least 15 days in advance. Continued use of the platform after the effective date implies acceptance of the new Terms.

law.title: 12. Governing law and jurisdiction
law.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Guatemala. Any dispute arising in connection with the platform will be submitted to the competent courts of Guatemala City, unless otherwise required by law.

privacy.intro: At KIOSQUI, your privacy matters. This document clearly explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and the rights you have to manage it. If you have questions, contact us through the channels listed at the end.

scope.title: 1. Scope of this policy
scope.body: This Privacy Policy describes what information KIOSQUI collects, how we use it, who we share it with, and the rights you have over it. It applies to everyone who uses the platform, whether as visitors, advertisers, agents, or companies. By using KIOSQUI you accept this policy, which should be read together with our <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms>.

data.title: 2. Data we collect
data.account: When you create an account, you provide your full name, email address, password (stored as a hash), and optionally your phone number.
data.profile: Avatar photo, cover photo, biography, general location, and social links — all optional and editable from your profile.
data.sensitiveIntro: For identity verification: DPI or passport number (individuals), valid NIT and RTU (companies), and a photo with the document. This data:

sensitiveItems.encrypted: Is stored encrypted with AES-256-GCM in our database.
sensitiveItems.supportOnly: Is exposed only to authorized support staff during review.
sensitiveItems.neverPublic: Is never shown in public profiles or open endpoints.

data.listings: Content you voluntarily upload: property photos, 3D files (GLB), description, address, price, features, and geographic location.
data.payments: When you purchase a plan or ad campaign, payment is processed through authorized providers. KIOSQUI does not store full card numbers or CVV — we only keep tokenized references and billing information required by law.
data.technical: IP address, user agent (browser and operating system), visited pages, searches, and interaction events. This data is used in aggregate to improve the platform.
data.communications: Messages sent to other users through the platform, comments on listings, and support tickets. These contents are stored to provide the service and resolve disputes.

items.operate: Operate the platform and allow you to use its features.
items.verify: Verify advertiser identity and reduce fraud risk.
items.payments: Process plan and ad payments through authorized providers.
items.notifications: Send operational notifications (comments, messages, status changes on your listings).
items.support: Handle support requests and resolve disputes between users.
items.legal: Comply with legal obligations (billing, anti-money-laundering, court requirements).
items.analytics: Improve the product in aggregate form (analytics, usage metrics).

sharing.title: 4. Who we share your data with
sharing.intro: Your data is not sold to third parties. We share information only in these scenarios:

items.infrastructure: Infrastructure providers (hosting, transactional email, storage) acting as processors under contract.
items.authorities: Authorities when there is a valid judicial or legal requirement.
items.users: Other users only the information you choose to expose (name, avatar, listings, comments).

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and browser local storage to:

items.analytics: Measure platform usage in aggregate form (analytics).

cookies.note: You can delete cookies from your browser settings, but some features (session persistence, preferences) may stop working.

rights.title: 6. Your rights over your data

items.access: Access: see what data we have about you. Your profile already shows the main items; for sensitive data you can request a report through support.
items.rectification: Rectification: correct inaccurate data from your profile or by asking support.
items.deactivate: Deactivate account (recoverable): from your profile, section “Sensitive zone” → “Deactivate”. Your account is paused but your data remains intact. When you sign in again, the account is automatically reactivated. There is no time limit to return.
items.delete: Delete account (permanent): from your profile, section “Sensitive zone” → “Delete”. This starts a 30-day grace period. During that period you can cancel deletion by signing in. After 30 days, we permanently anonymize your personal data (name, email, phone, DPI, photos); the minimum record needed for referential integrity (FKs in messages, tickets, transactions) remains but cannot be associated with you.
items.objection: Objection: reject marketing communications or certain non-essential processing.
items.portability: Portability: receive your data in a common, structured format.

rights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, create a <support>support ticket</support> or write to <privacyEmail>privacidad@kiosqui.gt</privacyEmail>.

retention.title: 7. Data retention
retention.intro: We keep your data for as long as necessary to:

items.active: Operate your account while it is active.
items.accounting: Comply with accounting and tax obligations (minimum 4 years for billing under Guatemalan law).
items.disputes: Handle possible claims or disputes (3 years from the last interaction).

retention.afterDelete: After deleting your account, personal data is anonymized (name, email, photo) while aggregate data needed for system integrity is preserved.
retention.auditIntro: As a legal basis of legitimate interest in fraud prevention, we keep an audit log that indefinitely stores irreversible cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) of the following identifiers from deleted or sanctioned accounts:

auditItems.email: Hash of the email address used.
auditItems.id: Hash of the DPI / identity document (if verified).
auditItems.phone: Hash of the phone number (if provided).
auditItems.reason: Reason for removal and date it occurred.

retention.auditNote: These hashes are not readable personal data — they cannot be reversed to the original value. They are used exclusively to detect when a user previously banned for fraud tries to return with different data, in which case we block the new registration. We do not share them with third parties and do not use them for profiling or marketing.

security.title: 8. Security
security.intro: We apply reasonable measures to protect your data:

items.encryption: Encryption in transit (HTTPS) and at rest for sensitive data.
items.passwords: Passwords stored as hashes with per-user salt.
items.documents: DPI, NIT, and RTU encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a server secret key.
items.roles: Role-based access control: only authorized support staff can view verification data.
items.monitoring: Activity monitoring and key rotation when incidents are detected.

security.report: No measure is infallible. If you detect a security incident, report it immediately to <securityEmail>seguridad@kiosqui.gt</securityEmail>.

minors.title: 9. Minors
minors.body: KIOSQUI is not directed to people under 18, and we do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we detect an account belonging to a minor, we will delete it.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy to reflect platform or legal changes. We will notify significant changes by email or platform notice at least 15 days in advance. The current version will always be available on this page, with the last updated date at the top.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.body:
For any question about this Privacy Policy or your personal data:

Email: privacidad@kiosqui.gt

Support: ticket portal
